paragraphs: R. Mallukh the Arab, who lived in Arabia. Rav Aḥa bar Azza (see his entry) sat before Rav Huna and said: R. Mallukh said that R. Yehoshua ben Levi said the law follows R. Shimon. He answered, 'Do you mean Mallukh the Arab? He said the law does not follow R. Shimon.' When R. Zeira went up, he found Rav Bivi saying: R. Mallukh said that R. Yehoshua ben Levi said the law follows R. Shimon. He told him, 'By the master's life, I, R. Ḥiyya bar Abba and Rav Assi visited R. Mallukh's place,' Ḥullin 49a. In R. Ammi and R. Assi's time.
